# OptaxOptimizer { #phasic.optax_wrapper.OptaxOptimizer }

```python
phasic.optax_wrapper.OptaxOptimizer(optax_optimizer)
```

Wrapper to use Optax optimizers with phasic's SVGD interface.

This class adapts Optax's functional optimizer interface to phasic's
object-oriented optimizer interface expected by SVGD.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**optax_optimizer**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[optax](`optax`).[GradientTransformation](`optax.GradientTransformation`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   An Optax optimizer or chain of gradient transformations.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

<code>[**optimizer**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[optax](`optax`).[GradientTransformation](`optax.GradientTransformation`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The underlying Optax optimizer.

<code>[**state**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[optax](`optax`).[OptState](`optax.OptState`) or None]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The optimizer state, initialized by reset().

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> import optax
>>> from phasic.optax_wrapper import OptaxOptimizer
>>>
>>> # Wrap any Optax optimizer
>>> optimizer = OptaxOptimizer(optax.adam(learning_rate=0.001))
>>>
>>> # Or use with gradient clipping
>>> optimizer = OptaxOptimizer(optax.chain(
...     optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
...     optax.adam(0.001)
... ))
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [reset](#phasic.optax_wrapper.OptaxOptimizer.reset) | Initialize optimizer state for given particle shape. |
| [step](#phasic.optax_wrapper.OptaxOptimizer.step) | Compute update using Optax optimizer. |

### reset { #phasic.optax_wrapper.OptaxOptimizer.reset }

```python
phasic.optax_wrapper.OptaxOptimizer.reset(shape, params=None)
```

Initialize optimizer state for given particle shape.

Called at the start of optimization to initialize the Optax state.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**shape**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[tuple](`tuple`)\[[int](`int`), ...\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Shape of particles array (n_particles, theta_dim).

<code>[**params**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[jax](`phasic.jax`).[Array](`phasic.jax.Array`) or None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Initial parameter values. If provided, used for optimizers that need current params (e.g., adamw for weight decay).

### step { #phasic.optax_wrapper.OptaxOptimizer.step }

```python
phasic.optax_wrapper.OptaxOptimizer.step(phi, params=None, particles=None)
```

Compute update using Optax optimizer.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**phi**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[jax](`phasic.jax`).[Array](`phasic.jax.Array`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   SVGD gradient direction of shape ``(n_particles, theta_dim)``: ``(K @ grad_log_p + sum(grad_K)) / n_particles``.

<code>[**params**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[jax](`phasic.jax`).[Array](`phasic.jax.Array`) or None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Current parameter values. Required for optimizers with weight decay (e.g., adamw). If not provided, uses internally tracked params.

<code>[**particles**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[jax](`phasic.jax`).[Array](`phasic.jax.Array`) or None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Alias for params, for compatibility with phasic optimizer interface.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[jax](`phasic.jax`).[Array](`phasic.jax.Array`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Scaled update of shape ``(n_particles, theta_dim)`` to add to particles.
